✦ About CampusMatch

Lost & Found, made smarter.

CampusMatch is a privacy-aware campus Lost & Found platform that helps connect Lost and Found reports through intelligent matching, secure ownership verification and staff-controlled handover.

Report Lost Item → Explore Reports
The Problem

Traditional Lost & Found depends too much on chance.

Reports can be scattered across notice boards, messages, spreadsheets or informal groups. Even when the right Lost and Found reports exist, connecting them can still depend on someone manually noticing the similarity.

→
The CampusMatch Approach

Turn separate reports into meaningful matches.

CampusMatch brings reporting, intelligent comparison, ownership verification and staff review into one structured recovery journey.

What Makes It Different

More than an item listing board.

CampusMatch is designed around the full recovery journey rather than simply storing Lost and Found reports.

01

Multi-Signal Matching

Lost and Found reports are compared using image attributes, descriptions, location, time, category and unique attributes.

02

Explainable Scores

Instead of showing only a final score, CampusMatch provides a factor-level breakdown so staff can understand why two reports matched.

03

Privacy-Safe Discovery

Public listings reveal enough information to discover relevant reports without exposing private ownership evidence.

04

Human-Controlled Handover

AI supports matching and verification, but authorized staff remain responsible for the final ownership decision and handover.

Built Around Trust

Three principles guide every CampusMatch interaction.

The system is designed to make item recovery easier without weakening privacy or ownership safeguards.

01

Match intelligently

Use multiple independent signals instead of relying on one attribute alone.

02

Reveal carefully

Keep ownership clues private while still making public discovery useful.

03

Verify before handover

A high match score alone never automatically proves ownership.

Powered by ServiceNow

One connected workflow from report to resolution.

CampusMatch uses ServiceNow to connect reports, intelligent processing, match records, claims, verification workflows, staff review and lifecycle management in one platform.

Our Goal
“Make recovering a lost item feel less like luck and more like a secure, guided process.”
Start with a report

CampusMatch can only connect what the campus shares.
